business_summary: Alto Ingredients, Inc. produces, distributes, and markets specialty alcohols, renewable fuel, and essential ingredients in the United States. The company operates in three segments: Marketing and Distribution, Pekin Campus Production, and Western Production. It offers specialty alcohols used in mouthwash, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, hand sanitizers, disinfectants, and cleaners for health, home, and beauty markets; grain neutral spirits used in alcoholic beverages and vinegar, as well as corn germ used in corn oils in the food and beverage markets; alcohols and other products for paint applications and fertilizers in the industrial and agriculture markets; and essential ingredients, including dried yeast, corn protein meal, corn protein feed, corn germ, distillers grains, and liquid feed for commercial animal feed and pet food applications, as well as yeast and gas liquid CO2 for human consumption. The company also provides fuel-grade ethanol used as transportation fuel additives and distillers corn oil used as a renewable diesel and biodiesel feedstock, as well as fuel-grade ethanol produced by third parties. In addition, it offers transportation, storage, and delivery services through third-party service providers. Further, the company operates alcohol production facilities. It sells ethanol to integrated oil companies and gasoline marketers; essential ingredient feed products to dairies and feedlots; and corn oil to poultry, renewable diesel, and biodiesel customers. The company was formerly known as Pacific Ethanol, Inc. and changed its name to Alto Ingredients, Inc. in January 2021. Alto Ingredients, Inc. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Pekin, Illinois.
business_summary_ko: Alto Ingredients, Inc.는 미국에서 특수 알코올, 재생 연료 및 필수 성분을 생산, 유통 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 마케팅 및 유통, Pekin Campus Production, Western Production의 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 건강, 가정 및 미용 시장을 위한 구강 세정제, 화장품, 의약품, 손 소독제, 소독제 및 세정제에 사용되는 특수 알코올을 제공합니다. 주류 및 식초에 사용되는 곡물 중성 증류주, 식품 및 음료 시장에서 옥수수유에 사용되는 옥수수 배아; 산업 및 농업 시장의 페인트 적용 및 비료용 알코올 및 기타 제품; 건조 효모, 옥수수 단백질 가루, 옥수수 단백질 사료, 옥수수 배아, 증류 곡물, 상업용 동물 사료 및 애완동물 사료 응용 분야용 액체 사료, 인간 소비용 효모 및 가스 액체 CO2를 포함한 필수 성분. 또한 회사는 운송 연료 첨가제로 사용되는 연료 등급 에탄올과 재생 가능한 디젤 및 바이오디젤 공급원료로 사용되는 증류기 옥수수유는 물론 제3자가 생산하는 연료 등급 에탄올도 제공합니다. 또한, 운송, 보관, 배달 서비스도 제공합니다.
